description: This file contains unit tests for a queue implementation, using Google Test framework, testing operations like insert, post, remove, extract, and flush on a QueueType object.

classes.name: QueueType
classes.description: Template class representing a queue data structure used in the tests.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Inserts an element into the queue with a specified priority or key.

methods.name: Post
methods.description: Posts or signals the queue with a specific element.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes an element from the queue.

methods.name: Extract
methods.description: Extracts an element from the queue, possibly with a timeout or priority.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns the current number of elements in the queue.

methods.name: Enable
methods.description: Enables the queue, possibly to start processing.

methods.name: Disable
methods.description: Disables the queue, possibly to stop processing.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Clears all elements from the queue.
